adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, which does `open(url).read` (open-uri) and then imports `doc.content` as a post with `cook_method: :raw_html`, causing `Post#cook` to return `raw` directly and the embed view to render it via `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. There is no sanitization applied to RSS content in `Jobs::PollFeed` (it uses `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` only) and `TopicEmbed.import` appends an `<a href='#{url}'>` without escaping beyond a loose `^https?://` regex, so XSS/injection risk is plausible and grounded in the code. Additionally, the added specs cover `.import` but do not cover `.import_remote` at all, nor do they test URL safety/SSRF constraints or HTML sanitization behavior for raw imported content.
